description: This Java class defines the 'ExecutePiggybackCommand', a command object used within a DevOps context to execute an arbitrary command embedded ('piggybacked') inside another command. It includes JSON serialization/deserialization, factory methods, and field accessors, along with relevant metadata and annotations.

classes.name: ExecutePiggybackCommand
classes.description: Final class representing a command to execute a piggybacked command within a DevOps operation, with JSON serialization support, factory methods, and equality semantics.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of ExecutePiggybackCommand with various parameter sets.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static methods to deserialize an ExecutePiggybackCommand from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getTargetActorSelection
methods.description: Returns the target actor selection path as string where the piggyback command should be sent.

methods.name: getPiggybackCommand
methods.description: Returns the JSON object representing the command to execute.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.
